verdict.rationale: BVNK docs confirm an API to send stablecoins/crypto to blockchain addresses (bvnk-docs-13, bvnk-docs-14, bvnk-docs-23) and webhooks for real-time status notifications (bvnk-docs-2, bvnk-docs-32), with a sandbox for testing (bvnk-docs-3, bvnk-docs-31). However, the docs do not clearly describe a 'stored recipient' object for payouts or an explicit payout status lifecycle (e.g., pending/processing/settled) specific to stablecoin sends — the closest status/lifecycle detail is for fiat bank payouts (bvnk-docs-11, bvnk-docs-24), not crypto wallet payouts. Missing for 10: explicit stored-recipient/beneficiary API for crypto payouts, and documented status-code lifecycle from initiation to on-chain settlement.
